notes.title: Major adjustments and updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843858/bd1f9e4ce5fac914f827fcd6717c17b4107faa28.png[/img]
As I am developing the game by myself, the update speed is slow. I hope you can understand
Has temporarily removed the Japanese and English versions,
The Japanese and English versions were remade,
Added to the overall world architecture of the game,
And more content was produced,
This update mainly shows the content of chapter 1,
The rest of the episodes will be updated quickly,
The following is the content of this update:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843858/19d11e4785a1769d9ae5a8d4a7774c912c70df31.png[/img]

Prologue adds card function selection,
Add the prologue plot,
The style of the game has been redressed, all using a unified pixel style,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843858/8dd5e791bee827a4e6850e4caf00fcc5bd6dda07.png[/img]

Updated in-game fonts to use pixel fonts,
Modified the in-game dynamic drawing display,
Added a hunger system,
Added prologue novice instructions,
To supplement the prologue's exploration content and plot,
Enhanced game horror effects, including ambient music,
Adding a new thriller,
Added screen function button,


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843858/20db050f1c3711434dce7e397c8f2df16e736930.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843858/7f65a7db8b51cd9466ca1dcb54fd2b7924d0286e.png[/img]
The initial map was modified and optimized,
Set more traps for the map,
Added hidden story and hidden quest,
- Added a random gold coin system,
Added a card collection feature,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843858/fb88597ab1cd4d1c93196dbf06fb614e404ecb96.png[/img]

Added the compass feature,
New mission system has been added,
New changes to the game's storage system,
New mazes have been added,
Added the partner feature,
Added partner collection,
Added a story collection feature,
Added a new combos mini-game,
Added a key collection feature,
Joined in the chase,
Made it possible to explore all visible objects in the game,
Removed the level limit and changed it to the fatigue system,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843858/d5244f9e1700e15635e47f803d9b3b7ccdbd8508.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843858/aebbf194681826f8bfb6bc91843dee8ad9dd3bde.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843858/7a988a791f926587292a4c4ca9ca2634355257f9.png[/img]
- Improved combat UI,
Optimized combat data,
The body damage has been optimized, modified to the picture click select
Added ICONS to combat options,
Added the gameplay of carrying and pushing boxes,
The effect of lucky value has been enhanced,
With more animation,
A limited set of available supplies,
Increased the difficulty of the game,
Added automatic encounter pursuit to enemies,
Added the game CG skip feature,
Added the input puzzle function,
New ways to solve puzzles,
New puzzles have been added,
Modified the GAME Over screen,
The main menu UI has been updated.

notes.title: Update the work
notes.content:
The feedback I've received in the last two days has been very valuable, and I'm going to do a lot of research on the comments and suggestions you've given me,

Start making updates to improve the quality of the game,

If there is any new content added, I will update it.

If you have any questions, you can leave a message to me at any time. I will reply you immediately on my account.

Now quiet for a period of time, mainly in order to do a good job in the game update work.

Won't go away, won't stop making updates until the official release,

Thank you for your support and encouragement! Thank you very much!
